description: Inspects a select-like control without changing its final interaction state; query only filters options discovered locally.

selector.description: Unique CSS selector for one select control.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the select control.

maxOptions.description: Maximum number of options to return from the current window.

purpose.description: Use this to read the current option window. For a complex popup, the response may keep it open so the Agent can combine DOM.getSemanticTree, Input.type, Input.scroll, or Input.click and then inspect the new window.

controlId.description: Current canonical ID of the inspected select control.

controlKind.description: Whether the control is native HTML or a custom popup.

selectionMode.description: Whether one or multiple options may be selected.

expanded.description: Observed expanded/open state of the control.

popup.description: Observed popup identity and relationship details.

optionWindow.description: Current locally observed option window and option IDs.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used for the control.

recoveredTarget.description: Snapshot details used when a stale target was recovered.

observation.description: Factual observation of the completed Action and its current visible result.

suggested_prompt.description: Action-specific next-step guidance based on the returned result.

selectionMode.description: Whether one or multiple options may be selected.

expanded.description: Observed expanded/open state of the control.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used for the control.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Factual observation that does not expose private runtime diagnostics.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Action-specific public details; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
